newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay stocks in choppy trade, cap sharp gains.
newsitem.headline: Bombay stocks in choppy trade, cap sharp gains.

text.p: ** (0600 GMT) - Profit-taking by local players clips
early gains in Bombay blue-chip shares
** Market in over-bought zone, operators likely to offload
ahead of end-eccount trade on Friday, traders say
** Benchmark Bombay index up 8.55 points at 4,342.45 --
** Traders say technical correction due after rising for
the sixth successive day, soaring more than six pct
** Market eyes election of leader in Prime Minister Inder
Kumar Gujral's party which is overshadowed by corruption
allegations and prospects of a bitter split in its ranks
